title: Storm Sorceress Over Fleet
description: A powerful female sorceress with long pink and white hair floats above a stormy sea, wielding a glowing green staff. She summons a massive swirling vortex of turquoise magic, runes, and butterflies that engulfs several wooden sailing ships in a turbulent, lightning-filled sky with heavy rain.
